newsitem.title: USA: CKE Restaurants to acquire Hardee's-report.
newsitem.headline: CKE Restaurants to acquire Hardee's-report.

text.p: CKE Restaurants Inc will acquire the Hardee's fast-food chain from Imasco Ltd in a $500 million to $600 million deal, according to a press release issued Sunday by Advertising Age magazine.

Advertising Age said neither CKE Restaurants nor Imasco would comment on the story. The companies were not immediately available to comment when contacted by Reuters. Advertising Age magazine was also not available for comment.
According to the press release, CKE plans to expand the territory of its Carl's Jr. restaurant chain by converting Hardee's units west of the Mississippi and possibly in the rest of the country.
Imasco Ltd is based in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. CKE Restaurants is based in Anaheim, Calif.
